model.title: Canterbury Shaker Village National Heritage Area Study Authorization Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior, working with New Hampshire historic preservation officers, historical societies, tourism offices, and other groups, to study whether the Canterbury Shaker Village National Historic Landmark area in Merrimack County, New Hampshire, should be designated a National Heritage Area called the Canterbury Shaker Village National Heritage Area. The study would assess whether that designation is suitable and feasible.
